release_name: Source Link Repair — diocese site restructure
notes: The Diocese of Port Louis restructured its website: all 47 /diocese/les-paroisses/... URLs recorded in the corpus now return 404, so every 'Source' link in the app was dead. Remapped all 410 rows to the new /paroisses-messes/<slug>/ structure. 111 distinct URLs, all verified HTTP 200. Schedule data untouched — source_url is the only field changed (verified via pipeline diff).
